descriptionMarkdown:
A weapon with Reload X can normally make X attacks 
before it must be reloaded. Reloading uses an action 
unless a class feature, trait or item says otherwise. 
Reload X represents the current magazine, cylinder, 
charge pack or power cell, not the character's total 
ammunition. In standard play, ordinary spare ammunition 
is abstracted, and a character is assumed to carry 
enough routine reloads for the mission unless the GM 
says scarcity matters. Ammo Packs in Chapter 17 are 
used when ammunition is limited, an emergency resupply 
is needed, or specialist ammunition must be restored. 
Survival-focused campaigns may instead use Supply 
States from the GM Guide.
